title: A Lean formalization of pure information-sharing equilibria in competing supply chains
contribution_type: complete formalization of an established model theorem
claim: Under the exact platform Standing assumptions, ordered thresholds 1/2 < kN < kS < (3+sqrt(5))/4 classify all pure information-sharing equilibria in the three open regimes, with strict payoff dominance of full sharing in the middle.
